# Dōbutsu no Mori e+ PC/Android port v1.7.0

Version 1.7.0 of the port that runs [afe-decomp](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-decomp) (the どうぶつの森 e+ decompilation) on PC and Android.

## Changes since v1.6.1

All in the full touch mode (Settings → Gameplay → Touch controls → Full touch): **every part of the game is now
played by touch.** The GameCube pad no longer comes up by itself in any menu (only in the NES games, which are
played with it). Each menu takes taps and swipes; its keys stand on the right (▲▼ change a value, a check mark
finishes, the X leaves).

**Nook's catalog.** A tap on an item orders it (order / quit), a tap on a tab shows another kind, a swipe (or a tap
on its arrows) the next page.

**Designs.** The list of designs by tap. The design editor is drawn with a finger: the pen follows it (all its
sizes), fills, stamps and undo act where you tap, a shape goes from where the finger lands to where it is lifted. A
tap on a colour picks it, on the palette's button another palette, on a tool picks it (once more: its next kind).
Keys for undo, the grid and the eyedropper; the check mark asks whether to keep the design.

**Writing.** Letters (the address book: tap a name, swipe its pages), the notice board, the diary, the gyroid's
message, names: the Korean patch's keyboard as before, now without the pad over it, with keys for the text's cursor
and a check mark to finish. On the original disc a tap on the wheel picks the characters, with keys for its sets,
dakuten, space and backspace. The answers of "is this right?" and the diary's question are tapped.

**The other menus.** The post office's savings and loan (tap a digit, ▲▼ or a swipe), the clock, the alarm and a
birthday (tap a field, ▲▼ or a swipe, the check mark), the calendar (swipe for the months, tap a day, once more for
that month's diary) and the diary (swipe it, its write button), the town tune (tap a note, ▲▼, ▶ plays it, a clear
key, the check mark), the gyroid's storage (drag things to it, its price with swipes), the music player's records,
the memory card's designs and letters (as the pockets).

**Outside the menus.**
- In a room whose camera turns (the houses' rooms, the museum's halls), icons for the camera's angle and distance; in
  your own house a light switch icon. Until now only a pad's C-stick and D-pad turned them, and the on-screen pad has
  no C-stick.
- Keep a finger on yourself to hold A: the net is raised (drag to sneak with it, let go to swing), a piece of
  furniture is grabbed and pushed or pulled by a drag (in the island's cottage, where the furniture mode does not go).
- A tap on furniture in a room goes to the side it faces and uses it, and a chair or a sofa is sat on (the game sits
  you down when you walk into its front, which a tap did not do); on a chair or in bed, a tap or a drag gets up that
  way (until now nothing did).
- The morning exercise (and a room whose radio plays its music): a flick moves the way it goes. The v1.6.1 notes said
  a drag did; it did not (the game reads the exercise from the C-stick). Now it does.
- A tap while a message's text is still coming hurries it (B).
- An NES game shows a door icon that leaves it (L+R+Z: three fingers on the pad until now).

Things that are not items or villagers (the museum's exhibits, the lighthouse's switch, the statue, the information
terminal) are used as before: walk up to them and tap yourself (A).

- Signed with the same key as the previous version, so it installs over it (saves, the Korean patch and texture
  packs are kept).

## Updating

- **From v1.0.0 or later**, the game finds this version when it starts and offers to update (**Update now**; on
  Android, **업데이트** in the dialog). If GitHub answers with an error, try again a little later.
- v0.1.6 and earlier cannot update themselves: install this version by hand once.
- The multiplayer protocol is the same as v1.5.2's to v1.6.1's: they can be in the same room. 32-bit and 64-bit
  players can play together, whatever graphics API each uses.

## Read this first

- **No game data is included.** You need your own disc image of the Japanese 「どうぶつの森 e+」 **Rev 1 (GAEJ01)**
  (`.iso` / `.ciso` / `.gcm`) to run it. Disc images are not distributed.
- **To play in Korean**, download the Korean patch from [retrodb 한글패치 — 동물의 숲 e+](https://retrodb.info/krpatch/7428/%EB%8F%99%EB%AC%BC%EC%9D%98-%EC%88%B2-e)
  and apply it in the game (pause menu → Settings → Disc → Korean patch → Install...). The Korean patch is the work of an
  independent author (역전맞고) unrelated to this repository.
- Multiplayer: [README](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/README.md#multiplayer). For players from
  other networks, the surest way is UPnP turned on in the host's router, or UDP 47070 forwarded to the host's device.

## Files

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.7.0-Windows-x64.zip` | 64-bit Windows. Includes `SDL2.dll`; OpenGL 3.3, Vulkan 1.0 or Direct3D 12 (Windows 10+) |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.7.0-Windows-x86.zip` | 32-bit Windows (also runs on 64-bit Windows). Includes `SDL2.dll`; OpenGL 3.3, Vulkan 1.0 or Direct3D 12 |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.7.0-Linux-x86_64.zip` | 64-bit Linux. Requires SDL2 (`libsdl2-2.0-0`) and an OpenGL 3.3 or Vulkan 1.0 driver |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.7.0-Android.apk` | Android 5.0 or later, 32/64-bit ARM (armeabi-v7a, arm64-v8a); Vulkan on Android 7.0+ |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | SHA-256 of the files above |

## Verified

Played by script with touches on a 1280x720 window (menus opened directly where reaching them takes days of play):

- **The catalog**: a tap on a name brought "order / quit", a tap beside it closed the list, a tap on the wallpaper tab
  showed the wallpapers, a swipe the next page. **The designs' list**: a tap on a slot brought its commands.
- **The design editor**: a tap on a colour picked it, a drag drew an unbroken pen line across the canvas, a tap on the
  fill tool and then on the canvas filled that area, and the check mark brought the question, whose "yes" kept it.
- **A letter**: the stationery tapped, "write", a tap on "the recipient first!", a tap on a name in the address book,
  the editor with the Korean keyboard and no pad, the check mark, "is this right?" answered by a tap: the letter went
  among the player's. **The original disc**: two taps on the top of the wheel typed す.
- **The calendar and the diary**: a day tapped twice opened the month's diary, its write button the keyboard, the
  check mark its question, and "may others read it?" took a tap on its left half (yes).
- **The clock**: a tap on the month and ▲ twice (11 → 1), a tap on "done" closed it. **The savings**: a digit, ▲ and
  the check mark. **The town tune**: a note, ▲, ▶ played it, the check mark brought its question.
- **The gyroid's storage**: an apple dragged from the pockets onto its slot brought "free / set a price / show only".
  **The memory card's designs**: a tap on one brought "grab / quit".
- **A room**: the angle and distance icons turned and moved the camera, the light icon switched the light. **A
  chair** placed with the furniture mode: a tap on it walked to its front and sat down; a tap below got up and walked.
  **The net**: a finger held on the player raised it, lifted swung it. **An NES game**: the door icon left it.
- The fifteen touch checks of v1.6.0 and v1.6.1, run on v1.6.1's release and on this version, log the same; their
  screenshots differ only where this version adds something (the text hurried by a tap, the room's icons).
- The 43 scripted scenarios run for every release give the same screenshots (921), logged positions and saves on
  v1.6.1 and on this version, touch off.
- All unit tests pass; the decomp changes are inside `TARGET_PC` only and the matching build's hashes are unchanged.
- Android: the release-key signature (certificate `db6fc1ad…`) and the version (1.7.0, versionCode 10700); the four
  files hold the same files as v1.6.1's.
- Not tried in the game: the morning exercise's flicks (they need the event or a radio playing its music), the memory
  card's letters (the post office's card), pushing furniture in the island's cottage.

## Known limitations

- With the Korean patch, Tom Nook's passwords cannot be typed (with a pad as well): their characters are the
  original disc's kana, which the patch's keyboard does not have.
- The SD card's photos and the GBA's designs stay out of reach (no such device on PC), as before.
- The full touch mode was checked with touches given by script on the desktop, not yet on a phone.
- The limitations of v1.6.x remain (see the [v1.6.0 notes](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/releases/tag/v1.6.0)).

Build instructions and detailed progress are in [docs/README.md](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/docs/README.md).
